scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix client & npm run dev --prefix server & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix client -- --run --passWithNoTests && npm run test --prefix server -- --run
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules client/dist server/dist
